scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config ../../firebase.json --project demo-peapod --only auth,functions,firestore,storage
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 test/conversationRetention.test.ts test/notificationDeliveryPolicy.test.ts test/unreadBadgePolicy.test.ts test/badgeSyncCoordinator.test.ts test/orphanAttachmentCleanup.test.ts test/pairingRateLimit.test.ts
scripts.test:badge: npm run build && tsx --test test/unreadBadgePolicy.test.ts test/badgeSyncCoordinator.test.ts && firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --project demo-peapod --only firestore "tsx --test test/badgeSyncLifecycle.integration.test.ts"
scripts.test:pairing: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --project demo-peapod --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "tsx --test test/pairingFunctions.integration.test.ts"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --project demo-peapod --only firestore,storage "tsx test/firestore.rules.test.ts" && npm run test:location-ownership
scripts.test:secure-pairing: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.json --project demo-peapod --only firestore "tsx --test test/securePairing.integration.test.ts"
